detailed_descriptions.en: Control one fighter in fast-paced arena battles. Aim abilities, move, and react in real time to outplay your opponents through positioning and timing. Or step back, set tactics, and watch your team fight. Win fights to earn gold, buy and sell mercenaries, and strengthen your roster. Discover classes with unique abilities, shape your team, and upgrade it across seasons. Put your team to the test in structured leagues and tournaments. Face powerful clubs and unique leaders, recruit rare champions, and climb your way to the top. Every run forces new decisions. Randomized stats, evolving rosters, and dynamic opponents keep each season different, while the market gives you new ways to adapt and improve. A medieval world where war has been replaced by arena combat. Clubs of mercenaries compete in structured leagues for power, gold, and prestige. Enter the arena. Climb to the top.
